about_hero_desc: Phuc Gia Uy & Associates Law Firm was established with the mission of providing professional, transparent, and dedicated legal services to businesses and individuals in Vietnam. With over 10 years of hands-on experience, we have become the trusted legal partner of over 200 businesses nationwide.

about_quote_author: — Founding Lawyer, Phuc Gia Uy & Associates Law Firm
about_intro_para_1: Phuc Gia Uy & Associates Law Firm was founded with the vision of building a professional, dedicated, and principled legal practice. From the very beginning, the firm adopted the motto "Understanding - Responsibility - Dedication" as its core values and guiding principles for all consulting and litigation activities.
about_intro_para_2: Understanding to accompany clients through every case; responsibility to maximally protect their legal rights and interests; and dedication as a sustainable professional commitment. On that foundation, the firm has steadily built its reputation and become a trusted legal partner for individuals and businesses both domestically and internationally.
about_intro_para_3: The firm focuses on providing legal services in key areas including: Civil, Criminal, Foreign Investment (FDI), Enterprise, and Licensing. With a team of experienced lawyers who are skilled in litigation and specialized in consulting, Phuc Gia Uy & Associates always strives to deliver optimal legal solutions to effectively protect clients' legitimate rights and interests.
